note: Published provenance names the source reference, never curator evidence (#1708). Register TEST (1, variant 2) has editions 2018 and 2020; Q (var 5) is documented only in 2018 and an [[errata.delivered]] entry adds it to 2020 with evidence that names SWECOV, an Operator ruling, an issue number and MONA across a blank line. The 2020 state publishes the correction class, the entry's case pointer and the storage-type facts; the delivery-coverage check still finds that attribution as one provenance element, so the build reports no issue; and the report ledger's case event keeps the evidence.
fails_if: the state assembly publishes a correction's decision provenance (class plus evidence) instead of `AppliedCorrection.attribution`, or the ledger case event drops the decision's rationale; or `catalog_dependencies.check_delivery_coverage` is not given the same attribution and reports `unexplained_delivery_fact_change` on v5 people/Q 2020

sources.description: Editions 2018 and 2020; Q documented only in 2018.
